title: Long Night of Museums Berlin 2026 - Quick Summary
items: **The Long Night of Museums is Saturday 29 August 2026, 18:00 to 02:00.** One ticket covers participating museums and the official shuttle.
**Choose three real stops and one flexible extra.** The organiser itself recommends no more than four or five museums.
Start with the area where you already are at 18:00. Berlin is too large for a citywide museum sprint.
Check the official programme for exact event language, museum hours, queues and shuttle details before you leave.
A small bag saves time because many museums require large rucksacks to go into a cloakroom or locker.
